title: UNION combines columns by position and names them after the first table

source.quote: Columns are combined by position in their respective tables.
The column names in the return table will match the column names in tableExpression1.
source.supports: names come from the first table

derivation: The second ROW has its columns named b, a, but its first column (2) goes under the first column of the result, [a], and its second ("y") under [b]. Matching by name would have put a string and a number in the same column.
